# WN Wellness Gym Equipment Nepal

> WN Wellness Gym Equipment Nepal (registered as Wellness Gym Equipment Nepal Pvt. Ltd., PAN/VAT 622379544) is a gym equipment supplier with a showroom on Tribhuvan Path, Sukhanagar-8, Butwal, Rupandehi, Nepal. It supplies, installs and services commercial and home gym equipment across Nepal.

## Services
- Complete commercial gym setup (layout planning, equipment selection, delivery, installation)
- Home gym setup
- Gym equipment installation
- Gym layout and design planning (free for new gyms)
- Gym equipment repair and maintenance
- Annual maintenance contract (AMC) for commercial gyms
- Gym equipment delivery across Nepal
- Gym setup for hotels, schools and offices

## Products
Treadmills, exercise and spin bikes, ellipticals, rowers, multi gym and cable machines, Smith machines, plate-loaded and pin-loaded strength machines, benches, racks, dumbbells and weight plates. Prices on request by phone or WhatsApp.

## Service area
Butwal and Rupandehi, all 7 provinces of Nepal, including Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Pokhara, Bharatpur, Siddharthanagar, Nepalgunj, Biratnagar, Birgunj, Dhangadhi and Hetauda.
